title: Operation Condor
goal: I can explain what Operation Condor was, using cuyo.

items: I can say what Operation Condor was and when and where it began, using cuyo.
I can name the countries that took part.
I can say what the Archives of Terror were and where they were found.
I can use cuyo, cuya, cuyos and cuyas to say whose.
I can use the new words for network, discovery and archive.
